key_idea: Each figure has 4 squares and must split into 2 pairs of squares that touch.
steps: Each block is 2 squares. 2 blocks make 4 squares.
In figure C, the bottom square hangs under the middle square of the top row.
That bottom square must pair with the middle square. Then the left and right squares are left alone, and they do not touch.
So figure C cannot be made.

choice_feedback.A: A is 2 blocks in a row, end to end.
choice_feedback.B: B is 2 blocks, one on top of the other.
choice_feedback.D: D is one block standing up at the top and one block lying flat at the bottom.
choice_feedback.E: E is one block on the top left and one block on the bottom right.
